subject: HelioBank: hotpatch validation artifacts + CAIQ mapping request
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@heliobank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@heliobank.com
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelioBank: request for hotpatch validation artifacts + CAIQ mapping

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review and our SOC 2 evidence collection, our security team needs the following for Redwood's vulnerability management/process: 

- A copy of the hotpatch runbook you follow when a Critical or High CVE is identified (we need the run-level steps and owners).
- A sample patch validation log for a recent hotfix (preferably with timestamps and outcome: tested/rolled back/success).
- A CAIQ mapping sheet that ties your VM cadence and hotpatch SLAs to CAIQ/SOC2 control IDs.
- Confirmation of your SLA targets for Critical and High CVEs (time-to-patch and time-to-validate).

We have a SIG submission deadline on 2027-03-10. Can you send the artifacts and a short attestation statement we can include in the SIG packet? If you can provide the items by EOD Monday (2027-03-01) that would be ideal.

Appreciate it — let me know if there are any NDAs/DRIs we should route this through.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Sr. Information Security Manager
HelioBank

---
NOTE: If attachments are sensitive, please provide redacted copies and a link to a secure drive.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@heliobank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelioBank: request for hotpatch validation artifacts + CAIQ mapping

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned and will provide the materials by EOD Mon as requested. Quick summary of what you'll receive: 

- redwood_hotpatch_runbook_v1.2.pdf (runbook with owners, escalation, and rollback steps) — non-sensitive copy attached.
- patch_validation_log_20270227.csv — sample run for a High CVE addressed last week (timestamps and test outcomes).
- caiq_control_mapping_20270228.xlsx — mapping of VM cadence and hotpatch SLAs to CAIQ and SOC2 control IDs.
- Short attestation: Redwood confirms that for Critical CVEs we target 30-hour remediation windows (triage -> patch -> validate -> roll out) and for High CVEs we target 90-hour windows; validation and rollback playbooks are executed per the attached runbook.

Jonas / Ben — can you confirm the sample log attachment is sanitized for HelioBank and add any supporting notes (particularly the regression test checklist used during validation)? If either of you spot PII/secret material, please redact before we share.

Marta — attaching the runbook now; I'll send the logs and mapping as separate attachments within the hour after cleanup.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_hotpatch_runbook_v1.2.pdf (runbook, redacted)

"Redwood Inference attests that the attached hotpatch runbook and sample validation log reflect our standard vulnerability management and hotpatch processes as of 2027-02-28.
